setting: The story unfolds in the ancient kingdoms of Ayodhya and Lanka during the epic battle of Vijayadashami.

episodes.title: राम जी की कथा: विजय दशहरा — रावण का विनाश ब्रह्मा बाण से
episodes.description: विजयदशमी की रात, जब अंधकार पर प्रकाश की जंग छेड़ती है, सुनिए वह अद्भुत कथा जिसमें राम जी ने ब्रह्मा बाण से रावण को पराजित किया। इस महाकाव्य में विभीषण के रहस्य और अमृत की शक्ति का उजागर होना दर्शाता है कि सत्य की जीत हमेशा होती है।
episodes.summary: On the eve of Vijayadashami, the sky over Ayodhya shudders as the armies of Lanka march forward, and Rama prepares for the final confrontation. The tension rises when Vibhishana, torn between loyalty and righteousness, steps forward to reveal the secret of the amrit hidden in Ravana's navel, urging Rama to seek divine aid. This revelation sets the stage for a celestial intervention that promises to turn the tide of war. Guided by Vibhishana’s counsel, Rama ascends to the heavens where Brahma bestows upon him the radiant Brahma arrow, infused with the essence of the amrit. With the arrow in hand, Rama, accompanied by Lakshmana and the devoted Hanuman, leads the charge into the heart of Lanka, confronting Ravana amidst thunderous battle cries. The clash is fierce, emotions flare, and the fate of both realms hangs on the divine projectile’s flight. In a climactic moment, Rama releases the Brahma arrow, which pierces Ravana’s ten heads, ending the tyrant’s reign and restoring dharma. The battlefield falls silent as the victorious forces celebrate the triumph of good over evil, and Rama blesses all who uphold truth. The story concludes with a heartfelt benediction: may the light of Vijayadashami guide us all toward righteousness.
